Rumor says that a seal somewhere in Hell has weakened.
The player's actions released a sealed wanderer.
An unfamiliar presence lingers near Lubras's base.
The released wanderer settled in Lubras's empty base.
story.cover.mythictrpg.lubras_private_bu: Lubras is said to have left briefly on private business.
story.presentation.mythictrpg.lubras_amu: As if he had found something amusing, Lubras laughed and vanished without explanation.
story.presentation.mythictrpg.lubras_inv: Following the trail reveals that a being freed from a seal is staying in Lubras's abandoned base.
story.presentation.mythictrpg.lubras_ret: Some time later, Lubras returned as though nothing had happened.
story.presentation.mythictrpg.lubras_ful: Lubras explained that the being accidentally released by the player had settled in the empty base, and that he had gone to investigate it himself.
story.hook.mythictrpg.investigate_lubras: Ask a god who may know why Lubras suddenly disappeared.
story.hook.mythictrpg.ask_lubras_full_st: Ask the returned Lubras why he vanished and what really happened.
